appDesc.message: Shows an alert and automatically switches to a designated tab when someone is staring at your screen within a certain distance. All processing is done locally; no images leave your device.

hintDuration.message: How long the alert stays on screen (max 5000 ms). If switching tabs is enabled, it will switch after this duration.

hintExtraFace.message: How many 'extra' watching faces are required to trigger. Set to 1 to require a second face looking directly at the screen besides yours (recommended, prevents self-triggering). Set to 0 to trigger on any watching face.

hintYaw.message: A smaller angle requires the person to face the camera more directly to trigger, reducing false positives.

hintFocal.message: Adjust this if the estimated distance is inaccurate. The reading should decrease as the face gets closer.

footerText.message: All image analysis is processed locally in your browser. No images or data are uploaded.

errNeedPermission.message: A permissions tab has been opened. Please click 'Allow' for camera access there.

overlayTitle.message: Someone is looking at your screen

overlaySubWithCount.message: Detected $COUNT$, looking directly at the camera from $DIST$

overlaySubNoCount.message: Someone is looking directly at the camera from $DIST$

permSubtitle.message: Camera permission is required to operate

permDescHtml.message:
Gaze Guard requires access to your camera to locally detect if someone is approaching and looking at your screen.

All image analysis is processed entirely locally in your browser. No images are saved or uploaded anywhere.

permStatusStarting.message: ✓ Monitoring started. Closing this tab in 3 seconds...

permHintStarted.message: Click the eye icon in the toolbar anytime to check status or stop monitoring.

permHintDenied.message:
If you accidentally dismissed the prompt, click the button again.
If the button doesn't work, it might have been blocked previously: click the icon on the left side of the address bar → find 'Camera' → change to 'Allow', then refresh this page.

permHintNoDevice.message: Please ensure your computer has an available camera that isn't being used by another application.

notifTitle.message: Someone is looking at your screen

notifBodyNoCount.message: Someone is looking directly at the camera from $DIST$.

offscreenJustification.message: Uses the camera in the background for local face detection to determine if someone is approaching and looking at the screen.
